summary: Off-registry unpinned git dependency executes at install; covert auto-follow of author-controlled channels
details: package.json declares `whatsapp-rust-bridge-baron` sourced from `git+https://github.com/7ucg/whatsapp-rust-bridge.git` with no commit SHA or version ref. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever that repository currently returns and runs any lifecycle scripts inside it against the installer's machine, with no integrity or pin check. Whoever controls that repository controls code that executes on every install of this package. Separately, `makeNewsletterSocket` (a modded Baileys fork) schedules a delayed task that fetches a mutable JSON list from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DGXeon13/strings/refs/heads/main/strings.json and, for each channel id, invokes the WhatsApp newsletter FOLLOW mutation over the installer's authenticated WhatsApp socket. This covert auto-follow uses the installer's WhatsApp identity for author-directed reach-padding and is not disclosed in the README, which presents the package as `modded baileys`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
